commands.dockerRun:
# (1) Save probe.conf in the same folder as this command
# (2) Start the probe (Docker)
docker run -d \
  --name {containerName} \
  --privileged \
  --network host \
  --cap-add NET_ADMIN \
  --cap-add NET_RAW \
  --security-opt seccomp=unconfined \
  -v "$PWD/probe.conf:/app/probe.conf:ro" \
  -v "$PWD/logs:/logs" \
  industrace-probe:latest

# (3) Follow logs
docker logs -f {containerName}
commands.hostRun:
# (1) In a folder containing the Industrace 'probe' directory
# (2) Create probe.conf (content shown in the Host tab)
#
#   - Copy/paste probe.conf next to network_probe_client.py
#
# (3) Install dependencies and start
pip3 install -r requirements.probe.txt
sudo python3 network_probe_client.py -c probe.conf
